# Old-Games.ru — Russian retrospective

- Original source: [Old-Games.ru — Russian retrospective](https://www.old-games.ru/articles/42842.html)
- Author / publication: redwings / Old-Games.ru
- Language / date: Russian; 2010-10-03
- Access: Article text inspected
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

The author admires the detailed 2D scenery, music, interface, and humorous guard behavior. Sherwood's training, production, and recruitment are treated as meaningful parts of the strategy rather than merely a menu between missions.

Criticism focuses on an overabundance of generic recruits, abilities that receive too little use, and some dull objectives. The article also discusses the Noviy Disk Russian localization firsthand, praising its translated text, fonts, and character voices.

This is particularly useful for localization research and Russian player reception. Claims about party composition or campaign scale should be checked against game data before being used as implementation requirements.
